# Third-party art included in Hidden in Foam

Kenney — Factory Kit 3.0, CC0.
Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/factory-kit
Downloaded 2026-10-09. Original license: kenney_factory/License.txt.
Included: box-large, cone, conveyor, machine, crane, hopper-round GLB models
and their colormap texture. Models are resized/repositioned at runtime.

No Itch.io or Poly Pizza assets are bundled in this version. Other environment
props, hands, terrain shaders and audio are generated by the game's scripts.
